description: Post-AZ-II partial close at cutover.M. Cutover wave decomposed across the A–M sub-stages: cutover.A (substrate hoist + BBNF runtime + resolver-arm), cutover.B (Stage A/B byte-equal + permanent CI gate), cutover.C (scope-reveal — full close routes to D–H), cutover.D (consumer migration via 4 parallel agents), cutover.E (non-BBNF struct-direct substrates authored), cutover.F (3 emitter bug classes diagnosed + fixed), cutover.G (hand-written BBNF bootstrap parser at crates/core/src/grammar/bootstrap_parser.rs breaking the chicken-and-egg), cutover.H Phase 0 + Phase 1 (graph/deps value-expression skip; BBNF resolver-arm re-flip + transparent-rule emitter fix), cutover.I Phase 5 (BbnfBootstrap::serialize_compact_doc authoring + bbnf_rule un-ignore), cutover.K Phase 0-2 (bootstrap parser mapped_factor wrap, typed-leaf source-text recovery, per-shape Err paths close open compound frames), cutover.L Phase 3a (Keyword-shape Alt-of-Ref struct-direct emitter), cutover.M Phase 3b/c/d (CSV/Math/BNF/CSS Pretty resolver arms flipped to StructDirect; alt_dispatch struct_direct Alt-of-Literal/Regex/Seq emitter surgery). Tape deletion (Hard gate 1), EBNF activation, Parsed<R> deletion, and 17-entry bench refresh (Phase 6) defer to follow-on tranche under documented scope.
bench_matrix_note: Cold per-parse only (mimalloc, divan sample_size=1 × 100 samples). Compiled under [profile.bench] (fat LTO, codegen-units=1, debug=true for samply). Sheets parse_* and CSS L4 bootstrap aborted with SIGABRT under fat-LTO due to recursive-descent parser stack overflow — pre-existing per W2-act.recovery. cutover.H Phase 6 captured json bench refresh; bbnf bench fails because the divan harness uses BbnfBootstrap::parse directly (the codegen-emitted parser does not yet self-host real BBNF source — bootstrap_parser is the canonical entry point). Other bench entries retain cutover.E placeholder values; full refresh blocks on Phase 2 regen-fleet + Phase 3 Parsed<R> deletion completion.
